props.name: items
props.description: Item data array. Order defines visual order.

props.name: type
props.description: Whether one or multiple items can be open at the same time.

props.name: collapsible
props.description:
When `type="single"`, whether clicking the currently open item's header
closes it. Has no effect when `type="multiple"`.

props.name: openIds
props.description: Controlled open item id(s) — pair with onChange

props.name: expandIcon
props.description:
Custom trailing indicator icon rendered in place of the default chevron.

- Pass a `ReactNode` to swap the icon while keeping the default
  rotate-180°-on-open behavior.
- Pass a function of the item's open state for full control (e.g.
  swapping between plus/minus icons instead of rotating).

props.name: titleClass
props.description: Extra classes applied to every item's header button

props.name: panelClass
props.description: Extra classes applied to every item's panel content
